title: Chern-Simons deformations of the gauged O(3) Sigma model on compact surfaces
summary: Existence of solutions to the field equations of the gauged Chern-Simons-O(3)-Sigma model on a compact Riemann surface is proved by a topological method. Existence of a minimal deformation constant $κ_{*} > 0$ is proved, such that for any prescribed configuration of vortices and antivortices, at least one solution exists for $|κ| \leq κ_{*}$. For small values of the Chern-Simons deformation parameter $κ$, it is proved that the field equations admit multiple solutions, provided the total number of vortices and antivortices are different.
